source: docs/greater-anglia-d1/published-network.json (Nico oracle-clash-report, checked once against docs/london-se-national-rail-d1/published-network.json for the Liverpool Street stationGroup, 1 Sep 2026)
notes: National Rail (Darwin/OpenLDBWS) is structurally catalogued here but blocked at the account level — DARWIN_LDB_TOKEN not set. Same blocker as every other UK region packed so far.

Single primary agency (Greater Anglia). Thameslink/CrossCountry/East Midlands also call at Cambridge/Ely/Peterborough and pass the board-eligibility walk-up test alongside Greater Anglia — no doNotGroup needed at any Greater Anglia-owned station.

Hub lock Norwich (NRW). TWO secondary hubs, Cambridge (CBG) and Ipswich (IPS) — the oracle report gives both identical hub-tier language (report lines 22-24, 131), unlike West of England's single-secondary-hub shape. See hazard-pack.md H6.

Peterborough (PBO) is explicitly NOT a hub — flat throughRunningBoundary entry. LNER excluded there (board-eligibility verdict undecided, same open question as London & South East National Rail's own LNER gap at King's Cross — not resolved here). East Midlands/Thameslink/CrossCountry are in.
Colchester (COL) and Ely (ELY) are kept flat under regional, not promoted to secondary-hub status, per the report's own third-tier/junction language (lines 37-38).

Liverpool Street is NOT included here — Greater Anglia services calling there are already documented as `in` in London & South East National Rail's built pack (docs/london-se-national-rail-d1/stations.json / stations.json, Liverpool Street (Greater Anglia) stationGroup, groupId liverpool-street, doNotGroup true). Not duplicated.

CRS collision caught, not propagated: the oracle report's own station-code list (line 103) assigns LST to Lowestoft, but LST is Liverpool Street's real-world CRS, already used in London & South East National Rail's built pack. Lowestoft's crs is left null/crsVerified false here rather than ship the collision. Believed real code is LOW (National Rail's well-known station code for Lowestoft) but this pack could not reach a live GTFS/Darwin source to confirm it (network calls to transitfeeds.com and api.transitland.org both failed/blocked in this environment, nationalrail.co.uk's station page is client-rendered with no static CRS text) — left null rather than guess. Confirm against the Transitland GTFS feed (f-gc-rail~delivery~group~planar~gtfs) or a live Darwin payload before ever treating LOW as authoritative.

King's Lynn (KLY), Great Yarmouth (YRD), Bishops Stortford (BST), Stansted Airport (SSD), and the hub/secondary-hub/regional/boundary codes (NRW, CBG, IPS, COL, PBO, ELY, THF) are all carried through as reported but crsVerified: false — none cross-checked against a live GTFS dump or Darwin response in this pack (D2 gap, same as every UK National Rail region packed so far). Diss and Wymondham have no CRS at all — left null, not guessed.

Station scope is intentionally the ~13 stations the oracle report explicitly names, not the full 30-50 the report itself estimates for D1 — the remaining 17-37 stations are a flagged D2 gap (expand against the Transitland feed), not invented here.
Peterborough is flagged for a future multi-region ledger (cross-regional shared-platform de-dup with any East Midlands National Rail or LNER region Peterborough entry) — not resolved in this pack.

stops.name: Norwich
stops.class: hub lock — single terminus, single operator (Greater Anglia), Great Eastern Main Line terminus, interchange for Norwich-Cambridge, Norwich-Great Yarmouth, Norwich-Lowestoft branches

stops.name: Cambridge
stops.class: secondary hub — Great Eastern Main Line interchange; Thameslink cross-London through-running passes the board-eligibility test alongside Greater Anglia, no separate boarding-area layer required

stops.name: Ipswich
stops.class: secondary hub — major Great Eastern Main Line station, connections to London, Cambridge, Norwich, Peterborough; single operator

stops.name: Peterborough
stops.class: through-running/boundary point, explicitly NOT a merge or a hub (report line 25). LNER excluded — board-eligibility verdict undecided pending operator confirmation on unreserved-carriage walk-up policy, same open question as London & South East National Rail's own LNER gap at King's Cross. Flagged for a multi-region ledger at D2 (cross-regional shared-platform de-dup).

stops.name: Colchester
stops.class: regional hub (third tier) — Great Eastern Main Line, no through-running to adjacent regions except the already-documented Liverpool Street boundary

stops.name: Ely
stops.class: regional junction — Great Eastern Main Line (via Hereward Line) and Thameslink Cambridge branch meet here; Thameslink and CrossCountry pass the board-eligibility test

stops.name: King's Lynn
stops.class: branch terminus — West Anglia Main Line branch (Cambridge-King's Lynn)

stops.name: Diss
stops.class: branch-line junction/terminus, regional services only. No CRS given in the oracle report; not guessed here.

stops.name: Wymondham
stops.class: branch-line junction/terminus, regional services only. No CRS given in the oracle report; not guessed here.

stops.name: Great Yarmouth
stops.class: Norwich-Great Yarmouth branch terminus, regional services only

stops.name: Lowestoft
stops.class: Norwich-Lowestoft branch terminus, regional services only. Oracle report's own CRS list (line 103) gives LST for this station, but LST is Liverpool Street's real-world CRS, already used in London & South East National Rail's built pack — NOT used here to avoid a catalog-wide station-code collision. Believed real code LOW, not confirmed against a live GTFS/Darwin source in this pack; left null rather than guess.
